name: Jiǔlóng Mófǎzhèn
summary:
The name of the Kowloon Peninsula derives from the nine dragons sleeping beneath the earth. But humanity's relentless development and construction has begun to stir those slumbering dragons awake.
Legend has it that beneath the Kowloon Peninsula lies a magic circle — awaken the nine dragons sleeping within this land, make a wish inside the circle, and that wish will be granted.
To exchange this land for a wish, people will offer up everything they have. Let this city sink into ruin — for only through destruction can new life emerge. Come then! Seek out the Nine Dragon Magic Circle!
